// why: The library's fourth, disjoint program: the Vitest configuration for the mutation run and its setup file. They belong neither to the package (tsconfig.lib.json) nor to the specs (tsconfig.spec.json) — and without a program of their own no compiler would look at them, which `check-typecheck` (point 4) reports at once. Separate rather than glued onto `tsconfig.spec.json`, so that Node's types (`__dirname`) do not enter the spec program: those run in jsdom and are meant to break on reaching for a server API.
